info.title: ACME Compensation API
info.description: Backend API for the Next.js server. Browsers do not call it directly; no CORS is enabled.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a two-hour session token
post.description: Five failed attempts per caller and email address per 15 minutes; successful logins do not count.

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS: unknown email, wrong password, or inactive user (one response).

get.summary: Current HR user, scopes, and session expiry
Search, filter, sort, and page the employees in the caller's scope
get.description: Scope, filters, sorting, LIMIT, and OFFSET all run in MySQL. Totals count only employees in scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Employee ID (exact or prefix), first, last, or full name (partial, case-insensitive), or exact email (case-insensitive). "%", "_", and "\" are literal.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency of the selected compensation record.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Salary sorts compare unrounded USD values computed in MySQL from the saved rate, and require comparisonCurrency=USD. Ties break on employee ID.

parameters.name: comparisonCurrency
parameters.description: Required when sort is a salary field.

200.description: One page. A page after the last page has no rows and correct totals.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid, unknown, or repeated parameter; salary sort without comparisonCurrency=USD; or salary sort with no saved INR rate.

get.summary: One employee with selected compensation and full compensation history

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown and out-of-scope employees return the same body.

get.summary: Filter and sort values available inside the caller's scope

200.description: Values present in scope. Salary sorts are omitted when no rate is loaded.

post.description: Read-only. The server derives identity and scope from the Bearer token. Tools return permission-filtered cards; the answer text is model-written. At most 4 tool rounds and 45 seconds per request.

200.description: The answer, tool calls, cards, and limitations.

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: no model configured, model timeout, or provider error. Other routes are unaffected.

post.summary: Read-only MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC)
post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint exposing the same five read-only tools as the assistant. Use an MCP client. Requests with an Origin header are rejected with 403; GET and DELETE return 405.

rate.description: Quote units per one base unit: 1 USD = rate INR.

annualBaseSalary.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualBonus.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualCashCompensation.description: annualBaseSalary + annualBonus, in the native currency.

annualBaseSalary.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualCashCompensation.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

usdEquivalent.description: Display only: rounded half-up to cents. Null when an INR record has no saved rate.

comparison.description: Present for salary sorts. exchangeRate is null only when every row is USD (currency=USD filter).

exchangeRate.description: Snapshot used for usdEquivalent values; null when no rate is loaded.

annualBaseSalary.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualBonus.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualCashCompensation.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

version.description: Employee record version, for later stale-edit checks.

compensationHistory.description: Every record, ordered by effectiveFrom then version.

annualBaseSalary.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

annualCashCompensation.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

usdEquivalent.description: Display only, rounded half-up. Null when an INR record has no saved rate.

exchangeRate.description: Present when the list was ranked or shown with USD equivalents.

total.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

average.description: Exact decimal string with two decimal places.

usdEquivalent.description: Context only, not an authoritative total.

groups.description: One row per group and native currency. Currencies are never added together.

days.description: Window length, measured back from the current time by recordedAt.

recordedAt.description: When HR recorded the change (compensation_records.created_at, UTC). "Recent" is measured by this.

annualBaseSalaryChange.description: Null when there is no previous record or the currency changed.

answer.description: Model-written text. Treat figures in cards as authoritative.

status.description: rejected: invalid tool name or arguments, not executed.
